answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable bond before it can vote or trade, and slash that bond when peers prove it misbehaved, like a copper wire that only carries current once it is properly joined. One attacker can afford a single bond, but a thousand clones means a thousand locked bonds, and one detected fraud burns the whole cluster's stake. Legitimate newcomers still enter through a narrow inlet: small bond, small limits, growing only as honest history accumulates, so a grove of fake identities withers because its cost grows faster than its influence.
